name: Zeva Bliss's Centurion-class battlecruiser
description: Zeva Bliss's Centurion-class battlecruiser served the leader of the Spice Runners of Kijimi. Zeva Bliss used the battlecruiser to travel to the planet Judakann and collect her daughter Zorii Bliss and Poe Dameron and take to Kijimi as full members of the Spice Runners.
